questions.en: During the final second, did any musical material return from earlier in this performance, before that second? Count a return with changed pitch, speed, timbre or articulation as yes when you hear the same ordered gesture or phrase; a shared isolated tone or mood alone does not count.
questions.ja: 最後の1秒間に、それより前に聞いた音楽のまとまりが戻ってきたか。音高・速さ・音色・発音の仕方が変わっていても、同じ順序を持つ身振りやフレーズが戻ったと聞こえれば「戻った」を選ぶ。単独の音や雰囲気が似ているだけでは戻ったと数えない。

missing_and_invalid: No binary target; retain in assigned-trial denominators and report separately from unable.

delivery.before_playback: Display the query duration. Do not disclose candidate/foil identity, source labels or intended answer.
delivery.after_playback: Identify the final query interval on a silent time ruler; no waveform, audio scrubbing or subsequent audio.
delivery.cut: An experimental cut is not a musical ending. Judge the actually heard part of an ongoing realization.
delivery.query_schedule: A return candidate or matched novel foil starts at query start. Earlier ordered context is heard in the same uninterrupted prefix.
delivery.source_family: One prefix per family per participant; within-prefix prior occurrences are the exposure manipulation.

scoring.bank_copy: Freeze immediately before query start; only previously committed episodes are eligible.
scoring.elapsed: Advance by the actual query duration. No query reinforcement, competing-content updates or new episodes enter the scoring copy.
scoring.parameters: Shared tau, kappa, strength cap and bias across durations; actual elapsed time and duration-specific observed cue features enter the same law.
model_input_exclusions: cue kind metadata in place of measured match features
scoring.numeric_reference: memory-reference.json: pre-target immutable copy advances only elapsed time; actual descriptor scales and human/pilot gates remain open.

pilot.denominator: All assigned practice/control trials; unable, missing and invalid do not become correct answers. Do not exclude failed procedural-check participants to inflate rates.
pilot.correspondence_support: A separate correspondence cohort must establish that short queries contain heard ordered material. An isolated tone or mood does not qualify.
pilot.failure: Revise instructions/materials on development, register a new version and repeat with a new cohort; rerun recovery if the accepted query inventory changes.

allocation.population_scope: Candidate recognition-development fit allocation; separate correspondence, calibration and final validation counts are not yet frozen.
allocation.approval: No recruitment or expenditure authorized by this numeric design.
